ship-mark.title: The Ship Mark
ship-mark.start: Someone who wore your ship's mark came to Lumar long before you did.
ship-mark.done: A pilot of your line came here, met the dragon, and never left. Whatever they were listening for, the egg is listening for it too.

clues.text: A skeleton deep in the dragon's cave clutches a medal. The ship mark on it is yours.
In the sorceress's tower, a scroll sealed in red wax. The seal bears the same ship mark.
The tavern's oil painting: a ship under a full green moon, signed 'E.B.'
A traveller's compass at the inn that never settles on north.
The inn's guestbook, last entry, no name: 'The dragon is not asleep. It is listening.'
The dragon's egg glows faintly. Something inside is listening.

heron.title: The Heron's Cargo
heron.start: A galleon called the Heron broke her back on the Crimson reef. Somebody thinks her cargo is still aboard.
heron.done: H.M. charted the reef, hid the chart on the stack and went for the cargo through the dragon's caves. The pirates are waiting for the tide to do the same.

clues.text: A chest under an X on the sea stack: a reef chart and a note. 'The Heron's cargo is still aboard. - H.M.'
The Heron lies listing on the reef, her hold open to the sea.
In the pirates' tent, the same reef chart, the wreck circled twice.
Charcoal by the cave mouth, signed H.M.: 'Down the stairs, bear left, mind the lava.'
The Crimson Watcher keeps the camp's fire and tells you to keep away from the cave.

signal.title: Forty-Seven Point Three
signal.start: Enigma's antenna is still listening to something on 47.3 MHz.
signal.done: Okafor never left. The missing suit, the bedroll, the lantern, the drone tuned to the signal: someone is still aboard Enigma, answering it.

clues.text: The antenna array: signal detected on 47.3 MHz, source unknown, still listening.
The data core's logs: contact with command lost 72 cycles ago. 'No one is coming.'
The bay log: the skiff Wren left in 4402 and never returned. Okafor started repairs on the Kestrel.
Four hooks, three suits. The empty one is D. Okafor's.
A bedroll in Docking Bay 3. The lantern beside it is still lit.
A maintenance drone on the bench, tuned to 47.3 MHz.

brink.title: Echoes at the Brink
brink.start: Time runs wrong at the Brink. Things that happened elsewhere happen here too.
brink.done: Every echo at the Brink is of somewhere you have been. The hole isn't remembering the universe. It's remembering you.

clues.text: A sundial with no sun, its shadow pointing at the hole and growing.
A half-sunk ring of stone. Through it the stars are in the wrong places, and you can see your own back.
Steps that climb into nothing, the last few hanging loose and turning slowly.
An echo of Lumar: cobbles from a square you know, a lantern still burning, half a wall.
An echo of Arcadia: a slab of street still wet with rain that fell somewhere else.
An echo of a station: a server rack blinking the same pattern Enigma was transmitting.
A rockfall stopped mid-air. If you watch long enough, one stone moves.

null.title: NULL
null.start: Somebody has been spraying NULL around the District.
null.done: NULL is a crew. The broken cabinet is their drop, the kid runs their messages, and Club Void is where they meet. The chained gate is where they live.

clues.text: The alley gate, chained shut. Someone sprayed NULL on the bars.
A broken arcade cabinet flickers fragments of something hidden.
A stranger in the arcade: the old owner left something inside that broken cabinet.
The street kid asks for tokens, and watches the gate.
Club Void. A slot in the door opens, two eyes, and closes again.

crystals.title: Four Colours
crystals.start: The cartographer says each of Lumar's four islands grows its own colour of crystal.
crystals.done: Crimson, rose, sapphire, and whatever the stones on Midnight are guarding. The cartographer will want to hear it.

clues.text: The cartographer: four islands, four colours of crystal. Three mapped. Nobody maps Midnight.
Crimson crystals in a field above the reef, all leaning toward the ridge.
Rose crystals, harvested on Rose Cove.
Sapphire crystals, traded at Sapphire Port.
On Midnight Isle, stone sentinels guard the way to the sorceress's tower.

wren.title: The Wren
wren.start: Okafor has been listening to the same distress loop for seventy-two cycles. It's getting clearer.
wren.done: The Wren was waved off at Arcadia and spent its last burn going toward the dark. It reached the Brink and is still there, nose-first over the edge, falling so slowly it looks still. The loop Okafor hears is its call, slowed by the hole, only now climbing out.

clues.text: Dami Okafor, the engineer who stayed, in a garden off the relay deck.
The radio: "Wren to Enigma. We can see the edge. We are not afraid."
Five crew in flight jackets in front of a skiff called Wren. Okafor in the corner of every photo.
Marshal Ruiz waved the Wren off Skyport 7 in a storm. It turned toward the dark side.
At the Brink, a piece of Enigma's hull, its lights blinking the station's pattern.
The Wren itself, past the altar at the very edge, frozen mid-fall. Its running lights are on.

listeners.title: The Listeners
listeners.start: The monks of Midnight Isle kept a record of every ship that passed. The record is gone.
listeners.done: The monks listened to the sky from the moon pool and wrote down the ships they heard overhead - starships, on a sea world. Morwen keeps their book. Its last page names the Wren, and after it a skiff that hadn't been built yet. Yours.

clues.text: The abbey ruins: the monks kept a record of every ship that passed. The book is gone.
Carved over the tomb door, violet light inside: "THEY LISTENED TOO."
In the moon pool, a full green moon that isn't in the sky.
The graveyard of the drowned. One stone is new and still blank.
Through Morwen's telescope: something dark moving between the stars.
Morwen has the monks' book. She knows what's on the last page.
